accumulation: New accepted20 followed by unchanged remaining80; historical cancelled runs excluded.

launch.scope: Native full prefill3072, FP16 KV64x64, decode graph; no token compression

task_manifest.selection: Outcome-blind repair subset; see adjacent manifest.json for frozen algorithm.
task_manifest.invalid_output_policy: record error, execute STOP; count every fixed episode in denominator
task_manifest.model_inputs: Author policy: RGB-only current and up to eight historical observations, uniformly sampled from last200. No action text, motion feedback, target truth or self-written memory.
task_manifest.horizon_note: 400 primitive actions includingSTOP; no collision early termination or policy changes
task_manifest.action_parser: Author parser/action chunking: first two subcommands, at most3 primitive actions each; detect random fallback and mark failed STOP; no silent random action
task_manifest.differences_from_author_benchmark: Original frozen development subset and policy; repaired inference execution and explicitly documented precision recipe.
task_manifest.repair_manifest_role: FP16 base manifest; controller changes only model identity/precision metadata per configuration, then freezes run copy.

environment_evidence.renderer: software Mesa llvmpipe; simulated movement time separately recorded
environment_evidence.verification_scope: Saved engine versions, complete Habitat settings and environment source; historical Habitat binary/library digests were not recorded.

excluded_requests.fixed_input_and_tail_requests: All excluded; retained in each batch evidence.

limitations: 100 fixed development cases, not independent generalization or statistical equivalence.
Execution order is selected20 then remaining80; display order is original100.
HTTP P50/P95 are recomputed from every real request; queued zeroes, warmups and tails are excluded.
Decode denominator is actual forwards including work after HTTP completion; CUDA intervals include dispatch/idle.
Memory is the maximum of all200ms whole-card samples including desktop and prewarm; not a model-only instantaneous peak.
Evidence SHA inventory covers every artifact used by this audit; original PNG frame files are not independently rehashed.
Environment equivalence is checked against recorded versions/configuration/source; historical Habitat interpreter/library digests were not recorded and cannot be reconstructed.
Different controller SHA is permitted only as orchestration provenance; runtime/evaluator/source/selected-launch changes reject accumulation.
